model: exact right-Gram spectral weights with analytic cosine-Taylor proxies and Bernoulli moment readout
beta_condition: 0 < beta < pi/2, so cos(beta*x) is positive and decreasing on x in [0,1]
normalization_failure_case: normalization alpha is below operator norm

cases.name: square_gap
cases.description: full-rank square matrix with a separated minimum

shot_readout.warning: conditional shot model only; preparation attempts are counted in expectation, no circuit is simulated

cases.name: near_degenerate_minimum
cases.description: small gap between the two smallest singular values

cases.name: zero_minimum_overlap
cases.description: initial state has no component in the minimum eigenspace

cases.name: wide_full_row_rank
cases.description: wide full-row-rank matrix; right Gram includes a kernel

cases.name: rank_deficient_square
cases.description: square singular matrix; zero is the smallest singular value

cases.name: rotated_tall_full_column_rank
cases.description: non-diagonal tall full-column-rank matrix in rotated singular bases

limitations: classical diagonalization of small matrices; no quantum circuit or QSVT phase synthesis
conditional postselection probabilities are ideal spectral-model probabilities
polynomial boundedness follows from a Taylor remainder scaling argument; empirical grid maxima are diagnostic only
no end-to-end gate/query advantage is claimed
a zero initial overlap with the target eigenspace prevents convergence to that eigenspace
wide matrices target the zero eigenvalue of the right Gram unless the right kernel is excluded by an explicit promise
